text:
Maria Chen: quick sync — customer A wants a no-NAT onprem path. thinking about two patterns: 1) operator-relay (lightweight outbound relay in customer's DMZ) or 2) managed-egress-proxy (we host a proxy in their VPC). tradeoffs?
Sam Park: operator-relay is simpler for field ops but more dev+support surface. managed proxy reduces customer config but raises compliance questions.
Anil Kapoor: also need to consider upgrade path. operator-relay allows rolling upgrades with node drain; managed proxy would need routing cutover (harder).
Peggy (field): customer ops prefers minimal change to routing. they're ok running a small pod in DMZ but nothing that terminates certs. operator-relay that forwards TLS passthrough would be ideal.
Kate Reynolds: security note — passthrough reduces our ability to inspect traffic for anomalies. need to log TLS SNI at minimum. add KMS annex for cert lifecycle if managed-proxy.
Maria Chen: ok new constraint: prefer operator-relay with TLS passthrough + optional managed-proxy fallback for customers that want our SLA. sound ok?
Sam Park: yep. we should define two upgrade lanes: "operator-relay default" (in-place rolling upgrade, preflight health checks) and "managed-proxy canary" (route-shift with canary window).
Anil Kapoor: propose acceptance criteria for operator-relay lane: 1) preflight check script that verifies connectivity to control plane, 2) drain strategy using readinessProbe + evict, 3) automatic rollback on 5xx spike > 0.5% for 5m.
Peggy (field): add field checklist: IP allocation guidance, minimal firewall rules, example helm values, and a rollback playbook. I can draft templates.
Maria Chen: timeline — aim Q2 beta for field customers. owners: Sam (runtime) + Anil (upgrade infra) + Peggy (field docs). Kate to sign off security checklist.
Sam Park: logging: relay should emit per-tenant metrics: handshake latency, connect failures, TLS SNI. we can wire these to Console dashboards.
Maria Chen: customer communication: create short one-pager explaining operator-relay tradeoffs and upgrade expectations. Peggy to coordinate.
Anil Kapoor: config snippet for the preflight check (WIP):
```bash
# preflight check example
curl -sS --connect-timeout 5 https://controlplane.redwood-infra/ping || exit 1
kubectl get pod -l app=operator-relay -n redwood || exit 1
```
Sam Park: for canary lanes include a traffic-shift script that updates BGP/route53 entries and runs integration smoke tests.
Kate Reynolds: security signoff criteria: TLS passthrough flag default ON, SNI logging enabled, KMS usage documented, at-rest keys rotated quarterly.
Peggy (field): I'll open a doc and a customer template today. linking when ready.
Maria Chen: action items summarized: Sam -> implement health/metrics hooks; Anil -> upgrade orchestration + rollback triggers; Peggy -> field templates + comms; Kate -> security checklist; target beta outreach by 2026-06-01.
deploy-bot: reminder: created RFC draft #PR-412 in docs repo (https://git.internal/rfcs/412) linked to this thread.
Maria Chen: thanks team :thumbsup:
